verdict.rationale: Stripe explicitly documents an 'Issuing for agents' capability (docs-12/13/21) naming session-scoped virtual cards that auto-invalidate after use, paired with merchant/category/amount spending controls (docs-5/17) and real-time authorization webhooks (docs-4) that can enforce merchant locks, caps, and expiry—directly matching the story by name. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on third-party confirmation that the agent-specific card-issuance flow works as documented (community evidence here predates the agents feature and only covers general Issuing).
